title: applied-ml-experiment-scratchpad-2026-03-26-samira
content:
Daily scratchpad - Applied ML experiment notes (quick, messy)
Date: 2026-03-26
Owner: Samira Khan
Collaborators pinged: Jordan (latency measurements), Ethan (quant kernels)

Goal:
- Short: sanity-check 4-bit quantized weights for `redwood-7b-v2` on our Dedicated pool and validate prompt-level quality regressions for our top-10 customer prompts.
- Success criteria: no >5% drop in exact-match / semantic-sim drop vs float16 baseline on sampled prompt set; tail-latency under 120ms per token for target p50/p90 on Dedicated config.

Quick to-do (today)
- [ ] Re-run eval harness with consistency metric and log per-prompt diffs (runner: local-rank2).
- [ ] Collect per-token latency traces for quantized model on g4dn-like instance and Dedicated GPU (NVIDIA A10).
- [ ] Try alternative quant recipe: GPTQ-fused + per-channel 4-bit + outlier boosting (scale factor 1.2).
- [ ] Add failing prompts to prompt-regression suite and open GH issue if consistent.

Experiments run so far (notes):
1) run_id: q4-2026-03-25-a
   - recipe: naive 4-bit PTQ (symmetric, per-tensor)
   - eval: 120 prompts (top-customer-set), metrics: EM drop mean 8.4%, semantic-sim (embed cosine) drop mean 3.1%
   - perf: p50 token latency +18% vs float16, p90 +35% (bad)
   - notes: catastrophic on math-like prompts, hallucinations on long-context paraphrase prompts

2) run_id: q4-2026-03-26-b (today morning)
   - recipe: GPTQ-fused per-channel quant + outlier scale 1.1, KV cache left in fp16, activations quantized to 8-bit where supported
   - eval: same 120 prompts, metrics: EM drop mean 2.7%, semantic-sim drop mean 0.9%
   - perf: p50 token latency +5%, p90 +12% on Dedicated A10 emulation; on g4dn p90 still +30% (kernel mismatch)
   - notes: much better fidelity; still tail latency issues on g4dn due to fallback path in kernels (Ethan investigated, likely suboptimal cuBLAS path).

Immediate observations/ideas:
- Keep KV cache in fp16 - helps quality and avoids deserialization overhead.
- Try mixed recipe: GPTQ-fused for attention + per-tensor 4-bit for FFN with small outlier correction - might reduce kernel divergence and keep perf.
- Need to measure memory bandwidth impact: what is the host->GPU memcpy pattern for the fused kernels? Add tracing.

Prompt set & failing cases (examples to add to regression):
- prompt_017_short_answer: "What is the capital of Estonia?" -> quant model returned "Riga" in q4-2026-03-25-a but correct is "Tallinn".
- prompt_082_math_chain: long multi-step subtraction chain - quant model truncates intermediate steps.
- prompt_099_paraphrase-long: long context paraphrase prompt caused hallucinated facts.

Planned next experiments (ordered):
1) q4-2026-03-26-c: mixed quant recipe (GPTQ attention + per-tensor FFN, outlier 1.15), run on Dedicated A10 real hardware; collect full traces.
2) q4-2026-03-27-a: try 3-bit per-channel for attention (aggressive) on small devset to probe quality cliff.
3) A/B rollout config for Redwood Dedicated: create canary route with quantized model + automatic fallback to float16 for top-1 failing prompts (policy by prompt-id).

Metrics to log in harness (ensure captured):
- prompt_id, input_len, output_len, baseline_tokens, quant_tokens, EM, BLEU-ish, embedding cosine to baseline, perplexity ratio, latency p50/p90/p99 per-token, mem-usage, kernel-fallback-count, kv-cache-serialize-size.

Action items for collaborators:
- Jordan: capture per-token p50/p90 traces on Dedicated A10 for run q4-2026-03-26-b and attach flame graphs (add to linked_artifacts).
- Ethan: check fused-kernel cuBLAS vs CUTLASS config - why g4dn uses fallback path. Also run microbench for GEMM sizes used in attention and FFN.
- Samira(me): add failing prompts to prompt-regression confluence page and sculpt tests for nightly evals; prepare GH issue stub for quant PR if regression persists.

Notes-to-self (quick):
- If we see >5% EM drop on repeated runs, abort rollout.
- Preserve random seed across quant runs for reproducibility and log the seed.
- Save model shards with suffix `-q4-gptq-a10-1.15` in s3://redwood-inference/quantized/ for traceability.

Useful links/refs:
- internal eval harness: https://github.com/redwood-inference/eval-harness (runner: harness/runner.py)
- previous run logs: s3://redwood-experiments/q4-2026-03-25-a/logs/

End of scratchpad - messy but actionable. Will clean into PRD if a stable recipe emerges.
